{{Quote|When I first arrived on Coruscant, I had nothing more than a second-hand Crisp-E-O donut droid and a dream&hellip; a dream serving good food to good folks.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
The '''Crisp-E-O donut droid''' was a type of [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] that prepared [[Doughnut/Legends|donuts]] using an internal [[Oil/Legends|oil]] fryer. A [[Dexter Jettster's Crisp-E-O donut droid|unit]] belonging to the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] had access to a database of over 2,400 donut recipes, and it prepared [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]]-style donuts daily after selecting the recipes it considered the most delicious. Jettster employed his Crisp-E-O on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] first at the [[Restaurant/Legends|food stand]] [[Dex's Donuts]], and later at the café [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Our Adarian-style donuts are made fresh daily by a genuine Crisp-E-O donut droid. Bright and early every morning, our Crisp-E-O unit sorts through its database of more than 2,400 donut recipes to choose the delicious varieties to be made that day using its internal oil fryer. You never know when you'll discover a new favorite.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
[[File:Creamygooey.jpg|thumb|left|100px|A donut, which the Crisp-E-O donut droid prepared.]]
The Crisp-E-O [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was a model of [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] that specialized in the preparation of donuts. It was equipped with an internal [[Oil/Legends|oil]] fryer, and its [[Memory bank/Legends|memory]] included a database of donut recipes; one [[Dexter Jettster's Crisp-E-O donut droid|unit]], owned by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], was able to access over 2,400 such recipes and choose what it considered to be the most delicious. The unit's database of donuts included varieties such as [[Dianoga cream-filled donut|dianoga cream-filled]], [[Powdered Christophsian sugar donut|powdered Christophsian sugar]], [[Yowvetch custard-filled donut|yowvetch custard-filled]], [[Muja fruit-filled donut|muja fruit-filled]], [[Iced Trammistan chocolate donut|iced Trammistan chocolate]], [[Iced Endorian maple donut|iced Endorian maple]], [[Iced donut with chopped ettel nuts|iced with chopped ettel nuts]], [[Iced donut with shredded Ishi Tib-cracked coconut|iced with shredded Ishi Tib-cracked coconut]], and [[Iced donut with dark matter sprinkles|iced with dark matter sprinkles]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==History==
{{Quote|Incidentally, that Crisp-E-O unit I started with still works the breakfast shift. Now that I've found success, I suppose I could replace it with a fancy modern droid, but being fancy isn't what we do here at Dex's Diner.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster obtained a second-hand Crisp-E-O donut droid and arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he opened the [[Restaurant/Legends|food stand]] [[Dex's Donuts]] on the corner of [[Zevanth Street]] and [[Avenue Peth]]. His Crisp-E-O prepared the donuts, which were on the menu alongside freshly-brewed [[Caf/Legends|caf]]. Several years later, Jettster received a settlement payment when an inattentive [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] [[Unidentified air taxi driver|driver]] destroyed the food stand, and he used the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to open [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a small café where he continued to employ his Crisp-E-O donut droid. It prepared [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]]-style donuts in its fryer daily. Although he could afford to purchase a newer droid, Jettster preferred the top-quality donuts made by his old model.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Dexter's Crisp-E-O donut droid (an idea also from the initial pitch) was inspired by a Doug Chiang drawing of a kitchen automaton that didn't make it into Episode II.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
[[File:Dougsdonutdroiddesign.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Doug Chiang's original concept art of a donut droid]]
The Crisp-E-O donut droid was first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a short story detailing the menu of Dex's Diner that was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and published online through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature in [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The Crisp-E-O was inspired by concept art<ref name="blog" /> of a whimsical donut droid by artist [[Doug Chiang]] that was originally intended to appear inside Dex's Diner in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Chiang's design ultimately went unused in the film's final cut,<ref name="mmmmmmmm">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/02/imageattack20030205.html|series=Image Attack|text=Mmmm&hellip; Donuts}}</ref> and Walker developed the Crisp-E-O due to a fondness for abandoned concepts.<ref name="blog" />
